lyrics.text: 刹那芳华凝于指尖，镜湖微澜倒映月弦
lyrics.sub_text: A fleeting bloom rests on fingertips over the mirrored lake

lyrics.text: 里章琴音悄然苏醒，唤醒沉睡百年的花影
lyrics.sub_text: The inner movement awakens hundred-year slumbering petals

lyrics.text: 一瞬满开即为永恒，与月光同频呼吸
lyrics.sub_text: One instant in full bloom becomes eternity in moonlight

lyrics.text: 落樱归于琉璃幻梦，余音仍在星河回荡
lyrics.sub_text: Falling blossoms return to glass dreams across the stars
